## What changed?

Describe the behavior change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Implementation is focused and tested.
- [ ] `/docs/` was updated for every user-visible, operational, architectural, API, configuration, installation, uninstall/removal, update, security, or troubleshooting change.
- [ ] Screenshots/help text were updated if the UI changed materially.
- [ ] API/protocol docs were updated if a contract changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, generated databases, logs, or local configuration are included.
- [ ] Pi Zero / ARMv6 impact was considered.
- [ ] Update/migration/rollback impact was considered where applicable.
- [ ] Installer ownership/uninstall logic was updated if any system path, service, user, helper, or persistent directory changed.
